decision: Selected the centroid of the union of the five Ellis County parcels that Red Oak zoning case ZC26-15 (Ordinance No. 26-032) names for its PD-66R8 Data Center Complex development plan (Property IDs 309733, 309734, 309735, 309737 and 191222) as the campus locator of that development plan. The point falls inside Lot 2 Block A Alamo Mission (309734); it locates the development-plan area, not any building, the registered 330 N. Austin Blvd. address or a surveyed boundary.

computed.method: Parcel polygons returned in EPSG:4326 by the TxGIO StratMap identify (envelope -96.802 to -96.784, 32.528 to 32.548); the five named parcels were dissolved into one polygon, its centroid computed in EPSG:32614 (WGS 84 / UTM 14N) and returned to WGS84; EPSG:5070 and EPSG:2276 cross-checks give the same point; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: The Red Oak City Council agenda for 13 October 2026 (posted 6 October 2026), item 9, and the Planning and Zoning Commission agenda for 28 September 2026 (posted 22 September 2026), item 2, describe zoning case ZC26-15: a change from PD-66R7 to PD-66R8 to approve a development plan to construct a Data Center Complex (and auxiliary structures), at the northwest corner of East Ovilla Road and State Highway 342, Property Identification Numbers 309733, 309734, 309735, 309737 and 191222 in the Ellis County Appraisal District.

The TxGIO parcel service returns exactly those five Property IDs in Ellis County: Lots 1, 2 and 3 Block A Alamo Mission (owner Alamo Mission LLC; 86.46, 42.15 and 37.50 legal acres), Lot 4 Block A Alamo Mission (13.60 acres) and a 6.95-acre J. Spoon survey tract (both owned by the Red Oak Industrial Development Corporation). Together they form one contiguous polygon of 186.6 geodesic acres.

Alamo Mission LLC is also the TDLR-registered owner of RED1A (TABS2025019071, 15 May 2025, 'new ground-up data center project', 330 N. Austin Blvd.), whose parcel situs neighbours (320 N Austin Blvd) fall in Lot 1.
unresolved: The development plan's site plan and building layout were not published with the agendas; the point does not locate any building.
The 13 October 2026 council decision on Ordinance No. 26-032 had not been published by 27 October 2026.
nearby_records: Within 2 km: the Compass Datacenters DFW III Campus (Red Oak) site and its Building 8 and Building 9 projects, whose campus locator is 0.74 km north-north-west. The Compass parcels (Project Cardinal-Rev and Project Cardinal II, Compass Datacenters DFW III entities) adjoin the development-plan parcels on the north and west but do not overlap them (0 m2 intersection with each of the 17 Compass parcels in the envelope). The DataBank Red Oak Campus is 5.5 km east. No other Atlas site, project, pending fragment addition, claim or hold coordinate lies within 2 km.
